• Design and develop the eLearning application based on agile 
development principles, integrating features such as short-from video 
content, interactive questions, and gamified elements such as leader 
boards, digital badges, and scores. Aligning the educational content with 
the attention span and media habits of the GCSE students. 
• Implement a comprehensive empirical study investigating the 
effectiveness of the application at improving engagement, retention, and 
content mastery rates among GCSE students. This study will compare the 
project against a control group using another platform that does not 
integrate the short form features. 
• Analyse the data collected from the empirical study to evaluate the 
effectiveness and impact of the application on learning outcomes. 
• Document the development considerations, study findings and final 
applications features in a comprehensive report outlining the research, 
development, and analysation stages. 
1.3 Project Overview 
Chapter 2 - Will delve into the existing research and theoretical foundations 
that underpin the project’s educational methodologies and framework. While 
additionally critically analysing existing solutions against these frameworks to 
identify gaps and trends within the market. 
Chapter 3 – Will build upon Chapter 2 and identify novel features, developing a 
holistic blueprint for the project, focusing on design decisions for enhance 
learning outcomes. 
Chapter 4 – Details the technical architecture of the project, emphasizing 
practical and pragmatic steps into turning the design into a real product.
